shared_elements: human head with eyes, nose and mouth
incised linear detailing of hair or texture
justification: Both depict a human head atop a torso with an arm, and both use incised linear marks to render surface texture (patterned beard/hair in A, hatched band and striations in B), but that is a near-universal subject. A shows a single strictly profile figure with elaborately curled beard, ear ornament and headdress rendered in careful low relief with regular decorative registers of curls, while B shows crude, frontal, schematic figures stacked one above the other with lozenge eyes and gaping mouth and almost no anatomical modelling — utterly different depictive conventions.
